note: Thomas County NE zones its land (AG, AGR, RC districts in planning agendas), but no zoning district layer is published as a queryable service. The county's ArcGIS host (thomascountymaps.org) has no Nebraska zoning layer: its zoning_landuse/Zoning service is Thomas County, Georgia data (Municode Georgia links, zero features in the Nebraska box). Planning and zoning pages offer only PDF agendas and regulations; no Nebraska city (Thedford, Seneca, Halsey) publishes zoning online.
